title: Master Page - Verify that The combination of Column Name and Column Type should be unique for each Data source type.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
User should redirect to the master page

steps.action: Enter the column name (Which already exist)
Select the column data type from the drop down
steps.expectedResult: Column data type should be selected
Error message should be populate for the duplicate entry and record should not be saved.
